label: token right after a "1 1" pair early in the original sequence
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.025% of steps). It fires during the original phase on the token right after a digit "1", almost always at t=2-3 (79% of mass). prev_tok==1 alone covers 83% of activation mass but has under 1% precision, so a preceding 1 is necessary but nowhere near sufficient. The strongest activations follow the bigram "1 1" at t=3 (e.g. q 1 1 [a]), and these are larger when the current token is o/w/e/a/p/t/z: that conjunction has 97% precision but covers little mass. The predicate (1 1 just before, t<=4) gets dev F1 0.41, mass recall 0.47. A weak secondary mode fires at the first copy step after <DEL> (recall_idx 1), often when the input is o. It does not fire at t=0-1, after t>=12, or in sequences with no digits. What else gates it, beyond the 1/1-1 context and the identity of the current letter, is not captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev2_tok=1 (+5.19), phase=2 & in_tok=o (+4.98), recall_idx=2 & in_tok=o (+4.91), prev_tok=1 (+4.66), prev_tok=y (+3.45), prev_tok=<DEL> (+3.33). Lower it: prev3_tok=o (-2.54), phase=2 (-2.38), in_tok=b (-2.26), prev2_tok=o (-2.24).
